Only methods declared in sugar-releases/src, or inherited from a parent declared there, are listed. A type that extends a class outside that tree, such as \RuntimeException, does not show the methods of that class.

SugarCraft\Releases

Lang final class

Per-library translation facade for sugar-releases (namespace releases). Strings live in ../lang/en.php; hosts with their own catalog inject a translator through SelfUpdate::withTranslator() / UpdateCheck::withTranslator().

ReleaseSelector final class

Pure selection over a decoded GitHub release list: which entry is "the latest" for one ReleaseSource, on either channel, independent of any transport.

MethodSummary
static for(ReleaseSource $source): self
selectRelease(array $releases): ?array
selectLatestRelease(array $releases): ?arrayThe target commit rides along lower-cased ('' when the entry names none) for latestDecision() to judge: selection stays decidable on assets alone, so a malformed target is the loud cannot-compare refusal, never a silent no-release. Tag names are unique per repository, so at most one entry can match; an asset-less latest entry is skipped.
latestDecision(string $current, array $release): arrayIs the running dev build already the commit the latest release names? [decision, label]: 0 up to date, 1 a newer commit is published, null INDECIDABLE — the current version carries no commit to match, or the release names a target that is missing or not a hex object name (a branch label). Indecidable is the fail-closed shape: --check reports cannot-compare, a swap refuses. A mismatch is never "behind": the rolling channel answers now or not-yet.
static parseSidecar(string $body): ?stringThe lowercase 64-hex-digit digest a sidecar signs with, or null when it is not that shape. Fails closed on uppercase hex, a short digest, and anything the sha256sum spelling does not produce.
static sidecarName(string $body): stringThe file name a sidecar declares after its digest ('' when it names nothing).

ReleaseSource final class

Where a phar-shipped tool publishes its releases, and what its artifacts are called. Every candy-code-specific literal the self-update engine used to carry (candy-code/ tag prefix, candy-code.phar asset family, detain/sugarcraft repo, the Composer package named in the refusal) is an input here.

MethodSummary
static new(string $repo, string $app): self
withTagPrefix(string $tagPrefix): self
withPharAsset(string $pharAsset): self
withPublicKey(string $publicKey): selfBase64 of the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key; '' is the keyless state.
withComposerPackage(string $composerPackage): selfThe Composer package the tool installs as (vendor/name), named in the composer-mode refusal.
withUserAgent(string $userAgent): self
releasesUrl(): stringFirst page of the release list (?per_page=100).
releasesPath(): stringThe only path a Link: rel="next" hop may name on api.github.com.
sidecarAsset(): string
signatureAsset(): stringThe LEGACY detached signature over the raw phar bytes.
sidecarSignatureAsset(): stringThe stream-safe detached signature over the sidecar body.
latestTag(): stringThe exact tag the rolling latest release is moved under.
composerCommand(): stringcomposer update <package> — printed verbatim in the composer-mode refusal.

SelfUpdate final class

Phar self-update engine: replace the running phar with the latest published one, verified before the swap, with the pre-swap copy kept for a one-shot rollback. Everything app-specific (repo, tag prefix, asset names, pinned key, Composer package, display name) is the ReleaseSource; the host parses its own argv into UpdateOptions and supplies the running version.

MethodSummary
static new(ReleaseSource $source): self
source(): ReleaseSource
withHttp(?ClientInterface $http): selfThe HTTP client (a test mounts a fake release server as a Guzzle handler).
withReleasesUrl(?string $releasesUrl): selfOverride the first release-list page URL (default: ReleaseSource::releasesUrl()).
withPharPath(?string $pharPath): selfThe phar to swap; null asks the runtime (\Phar::running(false)).
withPublicKey(?string $publicKey): selfOverride the pinned key for this run; '' is the keyless state, null reads the source.
withWindows(?bool $windows): selfForce the Windows relaunch-dance leg on or off; null reads PHP_OS_FAMILY.
withErrorStream(mixed $stream): self
withTranslator(?\Closure $translator): selfRoute wording through the host's catalog: fn (string $key, array $params): string receiving the selfupdate.* keys of lang/en.php with {app}/{package} filled.
withSwapLauncher(?\Closure $swapLauncher): selfReplace the detached Windows swap helper launch (default WindowsSwap::launch()).
run(UpdateOptions $options, string $currentVersion): intRun the verb. $currentVersion is what the running install reports (v1.2.3 or a dev-<sha> stamp); the host resolves it, the engine only orders it.
composerRefusal(?string $rootPackage = null): stringThe loud composer-mode refusal, verbatim: what to run instead, stated as the exact command — and the command fits the install shape: a consuming project is pointed at its dependency update, a clone where the tool IS the Composer root package at pulling the clone (composer update <pkg> there updates the package's dependencies, not the package). Public and pure so the wording is pinned without a non-phar "phar"; $rootPackage is the seam for the runtime's root-package answer.

Signature final class

Pure Ed25519 detached-signature check for release assets.

MethodSummary
static verifyDetached(string $payload, string $signatureBody, string $publicKeyBase64): boolIs $signatureBody the base64 of a signature by $publicKeyBase64 over exactly $payload? Every malformed shape — empty payload, non-strict base64, wrong-length raw halves, a missing sodium extension — answers FALSE (refuse), never an exception and never a trust. Surrounding whitespace is tolerated in both base64 slots because release-asset bodies carry trailing newlines.

UpdateCheck final class

The launch-time "update available" notice for phar installs.

MethodSummary
static new(ReleaseSource $source, string $stateDir, string $currentVersion): self
withFetcher(?callable $fetcher): selfTest seam: callable(string $url, array $headers): PromiseInterface<PSR-7>.
withPharPath(?string $pharPath): selfThe phar the install runs from; null asks \Phar::running(false).
withNow(?int $now): self
withOptOutEnv(?string $name): selfThe flag-style opt-out env var name; default <APP>_NO_UPDATE_CHECK.
withTranslator(?\Closure $translator): self
withLogger(?\Closure $logger): self
cachePath(): string
optOutEnv(): stringThe opt-out env var in force: <APP>_NO_UPDATE_CHECK unless overridden.
refreshIfStale(): voidFire the launch-time check. Returns as soon as the request walk is handed to the event loop; the cache write happens in its completion handler. Never throws, never blocks: every refusal path (composer install, opt-out, fresh cache, unbuildable transport) simply returns, and anything thrown by the wiring is swallowed into the once-per-process log line.
cachedNotice(): ?stringThe notice text, or null for "no row". Reads ONLY the previous check's cache file — never the network — and memoises per process. The cached answer is re-validated against the running version before it is returned, so a manual upgrade (or a downgrade, or a dev rebuild onto the published commit) silences a stale notice without waiting for the next check.
static resetForTesting(): voidDrop the per-process memo and the log-once latch (tests only).

UpdateOptions final class

The parsed shape of self-update [--check] [--rollback] [--allow-unsigned] [--channel=stable|latest], free of any CLI framework: the host parses its own argv and hands the engine this.

MethodSummary
static new(): self
withCheck(bool $check = true): self
withRollback(bool $rollback = true): self
withAllowUnsigned(bool $allowUnsigned = true): self
withChannel(?string $channel): selfnull = default channel from the current version. Validity is validate()'s call.
withOperands(array $operands): self
validate(): ?arrayThe first usage violation as [translation key, params], or null when the options are runnable. Order is the original verb's: exclusivity, channel, operands.

Version final class

The strict v?X.Y.Z ordering the self-update engine runs on, plus the dev-stamp classifier. Anything outside the grammar compares as null ("cannot order"), which every caller treats as "no swap": guessing the intent of an ordering it cannot express is how a dev checkout gets downgraded to the last stable tag.

MethodSummary
static parse(string $version): ?array
static compare(string $left, string $right): ?int-1, 0 or 1 as $left is older, equal or newer than $right; null when either side will not parse.
static isComparable(string $version): bool
static isDev(string $version): boolThe literal prefix rule and nothing more: dev-master IS dev, v1.2.3 and unknown are not.
static devShaOf(string $version): ?stringThe lower-cased commit of a dev-<hex4-40> stamp, or null for every other shape.

WindowsSwap final class

The relaunch dance SelfUpdate hands the phar swap to on Windows (C-TUI-6.e).

MethodSummary
static launch(int $parentPid, string $new, string $phar, ?\Closure $spawnSpec = null, ?array $env = null): boolLaunch the detached swap helper for a staged .new waiting on $phar.
